subject: general
question: Pankaj, Juhi and Siddharth invested ₹1,020, ₹1,740 and ₹1,840, respectively to start a business. If the profit at the end of the year is ₹1,050, what is Siddharth's share of the profit?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit ratio = Ratio of investments: **Pankaj : Juhi : Siddharth** = 1,020 : 1,740 : 1,840.

Simplified Ratio = 102 : 174 : 184 = **51 : 87 : 92**.

Total units = 51 + 87 + 92 = **230 units**.

230 units = &8377;1,050 ⇒ 1 unit = 1,050 ÷ 230 ≈ 4.565.

Siddharth's share (92 units) = 92 × (1,050 ÷ 230) = 92 × (105 ÷ 23) = 4 × 105 = **&8377;420**.

**∴ The correct answer is &8377;420.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Investment of Pankaj (IP) = &8377;1,020, Juhi (IJ) = &8377;1,740, Siddharth (IS) = &8377;1,840. Total Profit = &8377;1,050.

**Formula:** Profit Share = (Individual Investment ÷ Total Investment) × Total Profit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69cf26d1c94b4e401ff4c4b5d74dd70ff5661a16dd48d9a729db18130faaad46.png] 

⇒ Total Investment = 1,020 + 1,740 + 1,840 = **&8377;4,600**.

⇒ Siddharth's Profit Share = (1,840 ÷ 4,600) × 1,050.

⇒ Share = (184 ÷ 460) × 1,050.

⇒ Share = (4 ÷ 10) × 1,050 = 0.4 × 1,050 = **420**.

**∴ The correct answer is &8377;420.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Partnership Ratios

When the **time period** for investment is the same for all partners, the profit is distributed solely in the ratio of their **capitals**.

Compound Partnership

If investments are for different durations, Profit Ratio = (Capital₁ × Time₁) : (Capital₂ × Time₂).</p
